name: WORLD demo
postStartCommand: pip install -q -r requirements.txt && setsid nohup uvicorn app:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000 > /tmp/world-demo.log 2>&1 < /dev/null & code=000; for i in $(seq 1 10); do sleep 3; code=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' http://127.0.0.1:8000/api/state); if [ $code = 200 ]; then break; fi; done; echo "demo server http_code=$code"; if [ $code != 200 ]; then echo 'demo server check failed, see /tmp/world-demo.log'; fi
